'''Waks Burr''' was an [[Ishi Tib]]<ref name="SWVE" /> who visited<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> the [[Outlander Club]] in the [[Uscru Entertainment District]] of the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]<ref name="Coruscant">{{EncyclopediaCite|Coruscant (booklet)}}</ref> in [[22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref> Burr wore simple, [[Color|black]]-and-purple [[Clothing|overalls]] with a high collar, brown pants, and brown shoes while attending the club<ref name="SWVE" /> and was preparing to enter the building<ref name="AOTC" /> from [[Vos Gesal Street]]<ref name="Coruscant" /> alongside a [[human]] directly behind the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker]], as the [[Jedi]] entered in [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|pursuit]] of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell]].<ref name="AOTC" /> The Ishi Tib had green skin and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="SWVE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Waks Burr first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> which was released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The scene was filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="SWVE" /> The [[Waks Burr/Legends|character's]] name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 96|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 96]], a reference magazine<ref name="Fact File">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> written by [[Iain Lowson]]<ref name="FF Author">{{LinkedIn|url=in/iainlowson|text=Iain Lowson|archivefile=File:IainLowson-LinkedIn.png}}</ref> and released by [[De Agostini]] around [[October 29]], [[2003]].<ref name="FFDate">{{FFdates|96}}</ref>
